card.name: Mouse in animal toxicity studies
card.fires_on: The word mouse or mice, or the middle of 'tumorigenicity', in animal toxicity and carcinogenicity statements. It is most common after 'LD 50 ... in the'.

modes.example: The oral LD 50 of bethanechol chloride is 1510 mg/kg in the<< mouse>>.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about tests and experiments, as in animal studies.
card.plain: It fires on mouse or mice in animal toxicity statements, where lab test results are given.
